title: Provision situation and care needs of young people with post-viral symptom complexes: Status quo analysis and development of a care concept
summary: Many children, adolescents, and young adults experience long-lasting symptoms such as fatigue, concentration difficulties, or pain following viral infections like COVID-19. These symptoms are referred to as post-viral syndromes (PVS). The medical care for these young people is often insufficient. This study investigates what specialized healthcare services (e.g., clinics, social pediatric centers, private practices) exist for affected individuals, how these services are structured, and what experiences healthcare professionals have had when treating young PVS patients. The aim is to gain a better understanding of the current care situation and to develop suggestions for improvement.

interventions.name: Children, adolescents, and young adults with post-viral syndromes (PVS), especially after COVID-19, often face insufficient medical care.
